player_prompt.intro:
Yu em Player {player_id}. Yu i pleyim gem bilong Battleship.
Go bilong yu em i sinkim ol ship bilong pren bifo ol i sinkim ship bilong yu.
Long taem bilong yu, yu ken shot misil long koodineit spesifik olsem: '[a4]'. Sapos misil i pim ship, em i marikim 'X'. Sapos em i miss, em i marikim 'O'. Long eni kese, envairoment bilong gem bai talem yu long hit bilong yu. Sapos yu sinkim boat, envairoment bilong gem bai talem yu!
Gem i stap pinis wen ol ship bilong wanpela pleya i sink pinis.
Bored bilong yu bai sho olsem ol ship bilong yu i plesim pinis na pren i pim yu, na hit na miss bilong yu long bored bilong pren bai sho, tasol ship bilong pren i no sho.
Hia em i bored bilong yu:
